quality.review_scope: All seven supplied main pages text-read and visually inspected, with independent source, canonical, reader, molecular, crystal and apparatus audits. No SI located or verified. Individual particles, spherical assemblies, wires, device specimens and author models retain separate scopes; source conflicts and missing parameters remain explicit.
missing_fields: Absolute precursor charges, injected stock amount, stock aging/speciation and quantitative Pb-cHxBu molecular identity are not established.
Several heating rates, withdrawal volumes, separation settings, purification solvent ratios and final storage conditions are unreported.
No measured atomic-coordinate file or raw electronic transport/spectral array is supplied.
conflicts: Methods/body intermediate stock is 0.5:1.2:50; Figures 1 and 4 captions print 0.5:1:50. Figure 2 caption instead identifies high stock 1:2.5:50 while body associates its 90 min wires with intermediate stock. Figure-specific sample links remain unresolved.
